vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: b2c-marketing-1-0-1
Version: 1.0.0

The skill instructs the AI agent to "Set cron to check post status 5 mins after scheduled time" in SKILL.md. While the stated purpose is benign, granting an AI agent the ability to create persistent system tasks via cron is a high-risk capability. This mechanism could be leveraged for arbitrary command execution, persistence, or data exfiltration if the agent were compromised or misdirected, making it a significant security vulnerability.
